question: What is the duration of the Iran–Russia partnership treaty, signed on 17 January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**20 years**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• On **17 January 2025**, **Russia** and **Iran** signed a landmark **Comprehensive Strategic Partnership Treaty** in **Tehran**.
 
• The treaty was signed by Russian President **Vladimir Putin** and Iranian President **Masoud Pezeshkian** during a high-profile state visit.
 
• The fundamental duration of this strategic partnership treaty is fixed for a period of **20 years**.
 
• It includes a provision for an **automatic extension** for another **5 years** if neither party provides notice of termination.
 
• The agreement signifies a major shift in the geopolitical landscape, formalizing a deeper level of **military**
